# Lazy registry installation and dispatch

This family retains JavaScript registry subclasses, base dependencies, installer calls, receiver dispatch, and full parent scopes for capture-flow regressions.

[`native-reverse.js`](native-reverse.js), [`native-forward.js`](native-forward.js), and the ordinary variants exercise installed base protocols. [`staged-carrier.js`](staged-carrier.js) and [`dual-output.js`](dual-output.js) isolate staged receiver and two-output lookup transport. The constructor-transport, branch-carrier, and post-loop-copy full sources preserve broader origin context.

Consumed by:

- [lazy_registry_tests.rs](../../../../src/naming/classes/lazy_registry_tests.rs)

The multi-hop alias case is positive; [`native-reverse-second-alias-mutation.js`](native-reverse-second-alias-mutation.js), [`review-unreachable-install.js`](review-unreachable-install.js), and [`review-returned-constructor-mutation.js`](review-returned-constructor-mutation.js) retain independent refusal cases. Tests also check boolean channels, lookup divergence, preinitialization, extra effects, and unowned donors.

Preserve all installation and consumer relationships, not only class shapes. JSON provenance and [`regressions.json`](regressions.json) pin excerpt/correction relationships; keep their identities and source bytes unchanged.

Read these as static source inputs; do not execute recovered JavaScript.
